blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Cross-lingual zero-shot transfer and multilingual fine-tuning are promising approaches for NLP tasks such as Named Entity Recognition (NER) in low-resource languages, but in the absence of target language benchmarks, it is unclear which auxiliary language selection strategy leads to the best transfer. We introduce RunyaNER, 1 1 1 Dataset available at huggingface.co/uctnlp/runyaner . the first publicly available NER benchmark for the East African language Runyankore, and use it to investigate the choice of which languages to use for transfer.
Created with a semi-automated pipeline and fully manually verified, RunyaNER contains over 237k annotated words across 30k sentences.
We benchmark pretrained models on RunyaNER, establishing that our dataset is of sufficient quality and size to produce effective Runyankore NER models.
We then use RunyaNER to investigate auxiliary language selection in cross-lingual zero-shot and multilingual fine-tuning settings.
Our experiments show that while transfer performance is highly sensitive to auxiliary language selection, embedding-based measures computed from labelled training spans correlate more strongly with downstream transfer performance than traditional linguistic features based on metadata or typology.
By releasing RunyaNER and providing a systematic analysis of auxiliary language selection strategies, this work contributes both a new benchmark resource and practical insights for multilingual transfer in low-resource settings.
blocks.zh:
跨语言零镜头传输和多语种微调是NLP任务如以低资源语言命名实体识别(NER)的有希望的方法,但由于缺乏目标语言基准,尚不清楚哪个辅助语言选择策略导致最佳传输. 介绍RunyaNER, 11 1 数据集, 可用huggingface.co/uctnlp/runyaner。 这是东非语言Runyankore的第一个公开NER基准,
使用半自动管道创建,并经过完全人工验证,RunyaNER包含超过237k个注解字,跨越30k句.
我们在RunyaNER上以预先训练过的模型作为基准,确定我们的数据集具有足够的质量和大小,可以产生有效的Runyankore NER模型.
然后我们使用RunyaNER来调查跨语言零镜头和多语言微调设置中的辅助语言选择.
我们的实验表明,虽然转移性能对辅助语言选择非常敏感,但从标记的培训中计算的嵌入计量与下游转移性能的关系比基于元数据或类型的传统语言特征更为密切。
通过释放RunyaNER和系统地分析辅助语言选择战略,这项工作为在低资源环境下进行多语种转让提供了新的基准资源和实际见解。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Despite rapid advances in NLP, many African languages remain severely underrepresented in computational resources, benchmark datasets, and pretrained language models (PLMs) ( Mussandi and Wichert, 2024 ) . This imbalance limits the development of downstream NLP systems for large populations of speakers across the continent. In particular, many African languages still lack the annotated datasets required to train and evaluate PLMs on structured prediction tasks such as NER.
blocks.zh: 尽管NLP迅速进步,许多非洲语言在计算资源、基准数据集和预先训练的语言模型(PLM)中仍然严重不足(Mussandi和Wichert,2024年)。 这种不平衡限制了整个非洲大陆大量发言者的下游NLP系统的发展。 特别是,许多非洲语言仍然缺乏培训和评价诸如NER等结构化预测任务所需的附加说明的数据集。

blocks.en: Runyankore, a Bantu language spoken by over two million people in western Uganda ( Namyalo et al., 2016 ; Eberhard et al., 2025 ) , is one such underrepresented language. It belongs to the Runyakitara macrolanguage, which also includes closely related varieties such as Rukiga, Runyoro, and Rutooro ( Bernsten, 1998 ) . Although some efforts have begun to develop computational resources for Runyankore and related languages ( Katushemererwe et al., 2020 ; Bamutura et al., 2020 ) , publicly available benchmark datasets for downstream NLP tasks remain scarce.
blocks.zh: Runyankore是乌干达西部200多万人讲的一种班图语(Namyalo等人,2016年;Eberhard等人,2025年),是一种代表性不足的语言。 它属于Runyakitara宏语系,其中也包括与鲁基加,鲁尼约罗,鲁托罗等密切相关的品种(Bernsten,1998). 尽管已经开始为Runyankore和相关语言开发一些计算资源(Katushemererwe等人,2020年;Bamutura等人,2020年),但下游NLP任务的公开基准数据集仍然稀缺。

blocks.en: Table 1: Summary statistics for RunyaNER.
blocks.zh: 表1:RunyaNER统计摘要。

blocks.en: Beyond the absence of resources, an additional challenge for low-resource NLP is determining how to effectively leverage supervision from related languages for which annotated datasets are available. Multilingual PLMs ( Devlin et al., 2019 ; Conneau et al., 2020 ) enable cross-lingual transfer through shared multilingual representations, but transfer performance varies across languages and tasks ( Lauscher et al., 2020 ; Xu et al., 2022 ) . Recent work has emphasised the influence of auxiliary language selection, particularly in zero-shot settings where no target-language supervision is available ( Adelani et al., 2022 ; Eronen et al., 2023 ) . However, it remains unclear which notions of language similarity provide the most reliable guidance for selecting effective transfer languages.
blocks.zh: 除了缺乏资源外,对低资源NLP的另一个挑战是确定如何有效地利用相关语文的监督,这些语文有附加说明的数据集。 多语种PLMs(Devlin等人,2019年;Conneau等人,2020年)通过共享多语种代表实现跨语种交接,但交接性能因语言和任务而异(Lauscher等人,2020年;徐等人,2022年). 最近的工作强调了辅助语言选择的影响,特别是在没有目标语言监督的零镜头环境中(Adelani等人,2022年;Eronen等人,2023年)。 然而,尚不清楚语言相似性的概念为选择有效的转移语言提供了最可靠的指导。

blocks.en: In this work, we address both challenges by introducing RunyaNER, the first publicly available NER dataset for Runyankore, and using it to systematically study auxiliary language selection for low-resource transfer. RunyaNER consists of 237,076 annotated words (5,511 named entity spans) across 30,007 sentences. The dataset was created by annotating publicly available corpora using a semi-automated human-in-the-loop workflow, with all annotation and verification performed by one of the authors, an L1 speaker of Runyankore.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们通过引入RunyaNER(RunyaNER)来应对这两项挑战,这是Runyankore的第一个可公开获取的NER数据集,并利用它系统地研究低资源传输的辅助语言选择. 鲁尼亚 NER包含237,076个注解字(5,511个命名的实体横跨),跨越30,007句. 数据集是利用半自动的即时人工工作流程,通过对公开的Corpora进行注释创建的,所有注释和核实均由作者之一,Runyankore的L1演讲者进行.

blocks.en: We establish the first benchmark for Runyankore NER under monolingual fine-tuning, cross-lingual zero-shot transfer, and multilingual fine-tuning settings. We further investigate auxiliary language selection across 20 African languages from MasakhaNER 2.0 ( Adelani et al., 2022 ) , comparing metadata-based, typological, and embedding-based similarity measures. Our goal is to determine whether embedding-based similarity measures provide better guidance for auxiliary language selection than traditional linguistic resources.
blocks.zh: 我们在单一语言的微调,跨语言的零镜头传输,以及多语言的微调设置下,为Runyankore NER建立了第一个基准. 我们进一步调查了MasakhanER 2.0(Adelani等人,2022年)的20种非洲语言的辅助语言选择,比较了基于元数据、类型学和嵌入式相似性计量。 我们的目标是确定基于嵌入的类似性措施是否为辅助语言选择提供了比传统语言资源更好的指导.

blocks.en: Under cross-lingual zero-shot transfer, performance is highly sensitive to auxiliary language choice, with closely related Great Lakes Bantu languages yielding the strongest transfer. However, across the full set of auxiliary languages, embedding-based similarity measures computed from labelled training spans, particularly prototype cosine similarity and Sliced Wasserstein Distance (SWD), correlate more strongly with downstream transfer effectiveness than metadata-based or typological similarity measures. In contrast, once modest amounts of Runyankore supervision are introduced through multilingual fine-tuning, differences between auxiliary language choices become substantially smaller.
blocks.zh: 在跨语言零射转接下,性能对辅助语言选择高度敏感,密切相关的大湖班图语言产生最强的转接. 然而,在整套辅助语言中,基于嵌入式相似度测量从标定的培训跨度计算,特别是原型的同位素相似度和Sliced Wasserstein远程(SWD),与基于元数据或类型学相似度测量相比,与下游转移有效性的关系更为密切。 相比之下,一旦通过多语种微调引入微调量的Runyankore监督,辅助语言选择之间的差异就会大大缩小。

blocks.en:
To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of auxiliary language selection for African NER using both linguistic resource and embedding-based similarity measures.
In addition to introducing the first publicly available NER dataset for Runyankore, our findings provide practical guidance for multilingual transfer in low-resource settings and highlight the value of embedding-based similarity, when a labelled target training split is available for selecting effective auxiliary languages under weak NER supervision.
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,这是利用语言资源和基于嵌入的类似性措施,对非洲净入学率进行辅助语言选择的第一次系统研究。
除了为Runyankore推出第一个可公开获取的NER数据集外,我们的调查结果还为在低资源环境下的多语种传输提供了实际指导,并突出了嵌入式相似性的价值,因为贴有标签的目标培训可分为两部分,在薄弱NER监督下选择有效的辅助语言。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 NER with Multilingual PLMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 具有多种语言PLM的NER

blocks.en: Multilingual PLMs such as mBERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) and XLM-R ( Conneau et al., 2020 ) enable cross-lingual transfer by learning shared representations across languages. This allows supervision from high-resource languages to benefit low-resource languages in tasks such as NER ( Pires et al., 2019 ; Lauscher et al., 2020 ) , which has improved NER performance for many African languages ( Adelani et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: mBERT(Devlin等人,2019年)和XLM-R(Conneau等人,2020年)等多种语言的PLM,通过学习跨语言的共享表达方式,实现了跨语言的转移. 这使得高资源语言的监督有利于NER(Pires等人,2019年;Lauscher等人,2020年)等任务中的低资源语言,这提高了许多非洲语言的NER性能(Adelani等人,2022年).

blocks.en: However, transfer performance varies substantially across languages and depends on factors such as tokenisation coverage ( Rust et al., 2021 ) , morphological and syntactic divergence ( Lin et al., 2019 ) , and the degree of language representation in multilingual pretraining corpora ( Conneau et al., 2020 ; Ogueji et al., 2021 ) . Prior work has also shown that transfer is generally more effective between linguistically related languages ( Lauscher et al., 2020 ; Mahata et al., 2023 ) . Regionally focussed models such as AfriBERTa ( Ogueji et al., 2021 ) and Afro-XLMR ( Alabi et al., 2022 ) further demonstrate the importance of language relatedness in multilingual transfer for African NLP.
blocks.zh: 然而,不同语言的转移性能差别很大,取决于一些因素,如象征性的覆盖(Rust等人,2021年),形态和综合差异(Lin等人,2019年),以及语言在多语种预训蝎子中的体现程度(Conneau等人,2020年;Ogueji等人,2021年). 先前的工作还表明,语言相关语言之间的转移一般更有效(Lauscher等人,2020年;Mahata等人,2023年)。 AfriBERTa(Ogueji等人,2021年)和African-XLMR(Alabi等人,2022年)等具有区域重点的模型进一步证明了非洲NLP在多语种传输中与语言相关的重要性。

blocks.en: 2.2 Auxiliary Language Selection for Cross-Lingual Transfer
blocks.zh: 2.2 跨语言转移的辅助语言选择

blocks.en: A key challenge in cross-lingual learning is selecting auxiliary languages that maximise transfer performance. Existing approaches derive similarity metrics either from external linguistic resources or from multilingual representation spaces. Linguistic similarity measures are typically based on resources such as URIEL/lang2vec ( Littell et al., 2017 ) and LinguaMeta ( Ritchie et al., 2024 ) , which capture genealogical, phonological, syntactic, and geographic properties. Embedding-based approaches instead measure similarity directly in multilingual embedding spaces, including cosine similarity between mean-pooled embeddings ( Artetxe and Schwenk, 2019 ) and distribution-based metrics such as Sliced Wasserstein Distance (SWD) ( Nguyen et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 跨语言学习中的一个关键挑战是选择能最大限度地实现传输性能的辅助语言. 现有方法来自外部语言资源或多语种代表空间的相似性衡量标准。 语言相似度测量通常基于URIEL/lang2vec(Littell等人,2017年)和LinguaMeta(Ritchie等人,2024年)等资源,它们捕捉到家族学,唱片学,合成学,地理属性. 嵌入式方法则直接测量多语种嵌入空间中的相似性,包括平均拼合嵌入(Artetxe和Schwenk, 2019年)与分布式测量方法如Sliced Wasserstein District(SWD)(Nguyen等人, 2020年)之间的余弦相似性.

blocks.en: Several studies have shown that embedding-based similarity metrics correlate more strongly with downstream transfer performance than manually engineered typological or metadata-based features ( Shaffer, 2021 ; Philippy et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2021 ) . However, findings vary across tasks, models, and language families, making it unclear which similarity measures provide the most reliable guidance for realistic low-resource settings such as African-language NER.
blocks.zh: 一些研究显示,基于嵌入的相似性衡量标准与下游转移性能的关系比人工工程的打字或基于元数据的特点更为密切(Shaffer,2021年;Philippy等人,2023年;Yu等人,2021年)。 然而,调查结果因任务、模式和语言家族而异,因此不清楚哪些相似性措施为非洲语言NER等现实的低资源环境提供了最可靠的指导。

blocks.en: Example 1 Runyankore Elly Karuhanga PER {}_{\textsc{PER}} akahwihwisa ahabwa Kadaga PER {}_{\textsc{PER}} kutaayaayira faamu ya Museveni PER {}_{\textsc{PER}} . English Elly Karuhanga murmurs over Kadaga ’s trip to Museveni ’s ranch. Example 2 Runyankore African Union ORG {}_{\textsc{ORG}} omuri Addis Ababa LOC {}_{\textsc{LOC}} omukwezi kw’okubanza 2017 DATE {}_{\textsc{DATE}} . English African Union in Addis Ababa in January 2017 .
blocks.zh: 例1 鲁扬科雷 埃利·卡鲁汉加 临 时 翻译: 卡达加 临 时 穆塞韦尼 PER QQTextsc{PER} (韩语). 英国人Elly Karuhanga对Kadaga前往穆塞韦尼牧场的抱怨。 例2 非洲联盟 亚的斯亚贝巴 当地办事处 翻译: 2017 DATE QQTextsc{DATE}. 2017年1月在亚的斯亚贝巴的英属非洲联盟.

blocks.en: 3 RunyaNER Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 个 Runyaner 数据集

blocks.en: RunyaNER is constructed using two publicly available Runyankore-English parallel corpora: the Sunbird African Language Technology (SALT) corpus 2 2 2 https://github.com/SunbirdAI/salt-data-archive and the Multilingual Parallel Text Corpora (MPTC) ( Babirye et al., 2023 ) . SALT provides broader domain coverage, including news, public communication, and conversational content, while MPTC contributes shorter and structurally more regular sentences. After preprocessing and filtering, the combined corpus contains 30,007 annotated Runyankore sentences, of which approximately 72% originate from SALT and 28% from MPTC.
blocks.zh: RunyaNER是使用两种公开的Runyankore-英语平行corpora构建的:太阳鸟非洲语言技术(SALT)教程 2 2 2 https://github.com/SunbirdAI/salt-data-archive和多种语言的平行文本Corpora(MPTC)(Babirye等人,2023年)。 SALT提供更广泛的域名报道,包括新闻,公共传播,以及对话内容,而MPTC则贡献更短,结构更规律的句子. 经过预处理和过滤后,综合体包含30 007个注解的Runyankore句子,其中约72%来自SALT,28%来自MPTC.

blocks.en: All sentences were annotated following the MasakhaNER 2.0 guidelines ( Adelani et al., 2022 ) using four entity types: PER (person), LOC (location), ORG (organisation), and DATE (date). All annotation and verification were performed by one of the authors, an L1 speaker of Runyankore, and no external annotators were recruited. Before labelling, the annotator studied the MasakhaNER 2.0 guidelines and applied them to a short practice sample. Quality is therefore operationalised as exhaustive guideline-based correction by a single trained L1 speaker rather than inter-annotator agreement. To reduce annotation time, we adopted a semi-automated human-in-the-loop workflow. An initial seed set of approximately 500 sentences, drawn from both source corpora and including both entity-bearing and entity-free examples, was annotated manually. We then fine-tuned XLM-R ( Conneau et al., 2020 ) on this seed data together with Luganda training data from MasakhaNER 2.0, and used the resulting model to pre-annotate the remaining corpus. All predicted labels were reviewed and corrected manually in Doccano. 3 3 3 https://github.com/doccano/doccano Sunbird’s Sunflower machine-translation system 4 4 4 https://sunflower.sunbird.ai/ was consulted only when the English parallel was missing or fragmentary, and only as a reading aid.
blocks.zh: 所有句子都按照Masakhaner 2.0准则(Adelani等人,2022年)注解,使用了四种实体类型:PER(人)、LOC(地点)、ORG(组织)和DATE(日期)。 所有注释和核实均由提交人之一,Runyankore的L1演讲人进行,没有招聘外部注释员。 在贴标签之前,注释者研究了Masakhaner 2.0准则,并将其应用于一个简短的实践样本. 因此,通过一个经过培训的L1发言者,而不是在通知人之间达成协议,将质量作为详尽无遗的基于准则的更正加以实施。 为了缩短注释时间,我们采用了半自动的“即时”工作流程。 最初的一套种子大约500句,从源氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏 seed氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏氏 随后,我们对这一种子数据进行了XLM-R(Conneau等人,2020年)的微调,并与来自Masakhanner 2.0的Luganda训练数据一起,并使用所得出的模型预先对剩余生物体进行了注释. 在Doccano中对所有预测的标签进行了人工审查和纠正。 太阳鸟的葵花机翻译系统 4 4 4 https://sunflower.sunbird.ai/ 只有在英国平行缺失或零碎时才被咨询,并且只是作为阅读辅助.

blocks.en: Before annotation, both source corpora were normalised to remove encoding artefacts, irregular spacing, and malformed punctuation. Sentences containing severe formatting or structural errors were discarded. The final dataset was split into train, development, and test partitions using a stratified procedure to preserve consistent entity distributions across splits. Table 1 summarises the dataset statistics, while Examples 1 and 2 illustrate annotated Runyankore sentences with their corresponding entity labels.
blocks.zh: 在注释前,两个源头公司都实现了正常化,以去除编码工艺品,不规则的间隔,以及畸形的标点. 含有严重格式错误或结构错误的句子被丢弃。 最终数据集被分成列车,开发,并使用分层程序测试分区,以保持各个分区之间实体分布的一致性. 表1概括了数据集统计,而例1和例2则用对应的实体标签来说明注解的Runyankore句子.

blocks.en: Table 2: Monolingual fine-tuning results on RunyaNER (Baseline). Precision (P), recall (R), and F 1 -score (F1) are reported for each entity type and overall.
blocks.zh: 表2:RunyaNER(Baseline)上的单语微调结果。 报告每个实体类型和总体的精度(P)、召回(R)和F 1 - 分数(F1)。

blocks.en: Table 3: Zero-shot cross-lingual and multilingual (bilingual) fine-tuning F 1 results on the RunyaNER test set for all auxiliary languages, ordered by zero-shot mean F 1 .
blocks.zh: 表3:所有辅助语言的RunyaNER测试集上的零射交叉语言和多语种(双语)微调F1结果,由零射指F1 订购.

blocks.en: 4 Benchmarking PLMs on RunyaNER
blocks.zh: 4 RunyanER项目LM基准

blocks.en: This section establishes baseline results for Runyankore NER using multilingual PLMs under three supervision regimes: monolingual fine-tuning, cross-lingual zero-shot transfer, and multilingual (bilingual) fine-tuning with one auxiliary language. The aim is to compare how model pretraining and supervision regime affect Runyankore NER, and to provide a controlled empirical foundation for the auxiliary language selection analysis in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 本节在三种监督下使用多种语言的PLM确定Runyankore NER的基线结果:单一语言微调、跨语言零镜头传输和多语言(双语种)微调,辅语。 目的是比较模式性预训和监督制度如何影响Runyankore NER,并为第5节中的辅助语言选择分析提供可控的经验基础。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate three encoder-only multilingual PLMs: mBERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) , XLM-R ( Conneau et al., 2020 ) , and Afro-XLMR ( Alabi et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了三个只使用编码器的多语言PLM:mBERT(Devlin等人,2019年),XLM-R(Conneau等人,2020年),以及Africa-XLMR. (Alabi等人,2022年).

blocks.en:
Afro-XLMR adapts XLM-R through continued pretraining on 17 African languages, many of which are related to Runyankore.
This comparison allows us to examine whether broad multilingual coverage alone (mBERT, XLM-R) is sufficient for Runyankore, or whether regionally adapted pretraining yields additional gains.
We follow the MasakhaNER fine-tuning setup ( Adelani et al., 2022 ) , training all our models for 10 epochs with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) , a maximum sequence length of 164, and a batch size of 32.
blocks.zh:
African-XLMR通过继续预训17种非洲语言来适应XLM-R,其中许多语言与Runyankore有关.
通过这一比较,我们可以审查单是广泛的多语种覆盖面(mBERT, XLM-R)对于Runyankore是否足够,或者经过区域调整的预训是否产生额外收益。
我们遵循Masakhaner的微调设置(Adelani等人,2022年),用AdamW(Loshchilov and Hutter,2019年)为10个纪元培训我们的所有模型,最大序列长度164,批量尺寸32.

blocks.en: For evaluation, we report span-level micro-averaged precision, recall, and F 1 .
blocks.zh: 关于评价,我们报告跨度的微观平均精确度、回顾和F 1。

blocks.en:
We consider three fine-tuning regimes.
In the monolingual setting, we fine-tune only on the RunyaNER training split and evaluate on its test set. In the zero-shot setting, we fine-tune on MasakhaNER 2.0 training data for one auxiliary language and evaluate directly on the RunyaNER test set without exposure to Runyankore training data. In multilingual (bilingual) fine-tuning , we fine-tune on a combination of RunyaNER training data and MasakhaNER 2.0 training data from one auxiliary language, still evaluating on the RunyaNER test set.
The RunyaNER development and test partitions are used only for NER evaluation; they are never used to train a model or to construct a similarity metric.
We experiment with all 20 languages in MasakhaNER 2.0 (listed in Table 3 ) as auxiliary languages.
blocks.zh:
我们认为有三个微调制度。
在单一语言的设定中,我们只微调RunyaNER的训练拆分并评价其测试集. 在零镜头设定中,我们微调MasakhanER2.0训练数据,用于一种辅助语言,并在没有接触Runyankore训练数据的情况下,直接对RunyaNER测试集进行评估. 在多语种(双语种)微调中, 我们微调RunyaNER训练数据和 MasakhaNER2.0训练数据,
RunyaNER开发和测试分区仅用于NER评价;它们从未用于训练模型或构建类似度量衡.
我们用MasakhanER 2.0的所有20种语言(见表3)作为辅助语言进行实验。

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: Table 2 reports overall and entity-level results for monolingual fine-tuning. All three models achieve performance levels that reflect reasonably effective NER capabilities, with Afro-XLMR achieving the highest overall F 1 , followed by XLM-R and then mBERT.
blocks.zh: 表2报告了单一语言微调的总体结果和实体一级的结果。 所有三种模型都达到了能反映合理有效的NER能力的性能水平,African-XLMR实现了F1总体最高,其次是XLM-R,然后是mBERT.

blocks.en: This pattern holds across most entity types and is also reflected across precision and recall, with a small bias towards higher recall in Afro-XLMR.
blocks.zh: 这种模式存在于大多数实体类型中,也体现在精确性和召回性上,在Africa-XLMR中存在较高的召回率。

blocks.en: Afro-XLMR is considered a strong and well-established PLM for African languages. The fact that it achieves the best performance here reaffirms the value of regionally focussed multilingual PLMs. Even though Runyankore was not included in Afro-XLMR pretraining or adaptation, related Bantu languages such as Kinyarwanda and Kirundi were, which benefits RunyaNER through cross-lingual transfer.
blocks.zh: African-XLMR被认为是非洲语言的强大和成熟的PLM. 它在这方面取得了最佳业绩,这再次证明了以区域为重点的多语种可持续土地管理的价值。 尽管Runyankore没有被纳入Africa-XLMR预训或改编,但相关的班图语如Kinyarwanda语和Kirundi语,这些语言通过跨语言的转录使RunyaNER受益.

blocks.en: Table 3 summarises Runyankore NER performance under cross-lingual zero-shot transfer and multilingual fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 表3汇总 Runyankore NER在跨语言零镜头传输和多语言微调下的表现.

blocks.en:
For zero-shot transfer, performance varies greatly across auxiliary languages.
The strongest transfer consistently comes from Great Lakes Bantu languages (Luganda and Kinyarwanda), which are geographically and genealogically related to Runyankore.
blocks.zh:
对于零镜头传输,各辅助语言的性能差异很大.
最强的传承始终来自大湖班图语(卢干达语和基尼亚卢旺达语),这些语言在地理和族系上与鲁扬科雷有关.

blocks.en: Performance declines for less related languages.
blocks.zh: 不太相关的语言的性能下降。

blocks.en: This indicates that zero-shot transfer is highly sensitive to auxiliary language similarity. Afro-XLMR is generally more robust than mBERT and XLM-R in this regime, suggesting that regionally adapted pretraining is beneficial when the model must rely entirely on cross-lingual generalisation.
blocks.zh: 这表明零射转导对辅助语言相似性高度敏感. 非洲XLMR在这一制度中一般比 mBERT 和 XLM-R 更强壮,这表明,如果模型必须完全依赖跨语言通俗化,则经过区域调整的预训是有益的。

blocks.en: In the multilingual (bilingual) fine-tuning setting, adding one auxiliary language yields only modest improvements over the Runyankore monolingual baseline. The gains are largest for mBERT, whereas Afro-XLMR and XLM-R remain close to their monolingual results. This pattern suggests that models with broader multilingual coverage benefit more from additional cross-lingual supervision, while regionally adapted models already capture much of the transferable signal needed for Runyankore NER. The highest-ranked auxiliaries are again predominantly Bantu languages, although some more distant languages are also competitive once Runyankore supervision is included.
blocks.zh: 在多语种(双语种)微调设置中,增加一种辅助语言比Runyankore单一语言基线只产生一些微小的改进。 MBERT的收益最大,而African-XLMR和XLM-R仍然接近其单一语言的成果. 这种模式表明,多语种覆盖面更广的模型更多地受益于更多的跨语言监督,而经过区域调整的模型已经掌握了Runyankore NER所需的许多可转移信号。 排名最高的辅音再次以班图语为主,尽管有些比较远的语言在Runyankore监管被包括在内后也具有竞争力.

blocks.en: These results show that pretraining choice matters most under weak supervision. When Runyankore training data is available, all three models perform strongly and gaps are relatively small. In cross-lingual zero-shot transfer, however, the choice of model and auxiliary language becomes critical, with Afro-XLMR and closely related Bantu languages providing the strongest results.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,在监督不力的情况下,预训选择最为重要。 当Runyankore培训数据可用时,所有三种模式都表现强劲,差距相对较小. 然而,在跨语言零射线传输中,模型语言和辅助语言的选择变得至关重要,非洲-XLMR语言和密切相关的班图语言提供了最强的结果.

blocks.en: 5 Auxiliary Language Selection for Cross-Lingual Transfer
blocks.zh: 5 跨语言传输的辅助语言选择

blocks.en:
The substantial variation in performance across auxiliary languages motivates examining whether useful transfer languages can be identified systematically using metadata-based, typological, or embedding-based similarity signals.
In this section, we investigate which measure of language similarity is most predictive for selecting auxiliary languages that optimise transfer for Runyankore NER. Metadata and typological measures require no Runyankore NER labels; the embedding-based measures use gold spans from the training split only.
blocks.zh:
辅助语言之间性能的巨大差异促使人们审查是否可以系统地利用基于元数据、类型或基于嵌入的相似性信号来确定有用的传输语言。
在本节中,我们调查哪种语言相似度的衡量方法最能预测为Runyankore NER选择优化传输的辅助语言. 元数据和类型计量不需要Runyankore NER标签;基于嵌入的计量方法只使用从培训中分离出来的黄金间距。

blocks.en: Table 4: Spearman correlation ( ρ \rho ) between similarity metrics and Runyankore NER F 1 F_{1} across n = 20 n=20 auxiliary languages. Embedding-based ρ \rho is the strongest layer. We boldface the highest ρ \rho per metric type and underline the highest ρ \rho overall. ∗ p < 0.05 p<0.05 , ∗∗ p < 0.01 p<0.01 (two-tailed).
blocks.zh: 表4:类似度量衡与Runyankore NER F 1 F_{1}之间的斯皮尔曼相关性(^\rho),跨越n=20n=20辅语言. 基于嵌入的 $\rho 是最强的层 。 我们用粗体标出每个公尺类型最高的 $\rho , 并突出显示总体最高的 $\rho 。 * p < 0.05 p < 0.05, < 0.01 p < 0.01 (双尾)).

blocks.en: 5.1 Language Similarity Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.1 语言相似度测量

blocks.en: We compare four methods, two of which rely on traditional linguistic resources (metadata and typological features), and two of which are based on model representation (embedding) similarity (cosine similarity and Sliced Wasserstein Distance). We evaluate their ability to predict downstream performance under two regimes: cross-lingual zero-shot transfer and multilingual (bilingual) fine-tuning. Transfer effectiveness is measured using entity-level span F 1 F_{1} , and correlations are computed across 20 auxiliary languages and three encoders (mBERT, XLM-R, Afro-XLMR).
blocks.zh: 我们比较了四种方法,其中两种方法依赖传统语言资源(元数据和类型特征),而两种方法则基于模型代表(嵌入)相似性(Cosine相似性和Sliced Wasserstein district). 我们评价它们在两种制度下预测下游业绩的能力:跨语言零镜头传输和多语种(双语)微调。 转移有效性是通过实体一级跨度F 1 FQQQ1}衡量的,20种辅助语言和3种编码器(mBERT、XLM-R、African-XLMR)之间的关联性计算出来的。

blocks.en: The four metrics differ in the target-language supervision they require. LinguaMeta and URIEL are computed from published metadata and typological inventories and need no Runyankore NER labels. Prototype cosine similarity and SWD compare gold entity-span embeddings. For both embedding metrics, we extract spans only from the RunyaNER training split and from the MasakhaNER 2.0 training splits of the auxiliary languages. The development and test partitions are never used to construct prototypes or span distributions. Embedding-based selection is therefore not a no-label procedure: it assumes a labelled target training set, or an equivalent seed of gold spans. What it does not use is the evaluation set, so the subsequent transfer experiments remain uncontaminated. We treat LinguaMeta and URIEL as the label-free baselines against which these span-based measures are compared.
blocks.zh: 四个衡量标准在它们所需要的目标语言监督方面有所不同。 LinguaMeta和URIEL是根据已公布的元数据和类型清单计算的,不需要Runyankore NER标签。 原型的余弦相似,社署比较金实体-span嵌入. 对于两个嵌入度量衡,我们只从RunyaNER训练分解和Masakhanner2.0训练分解中提取。 开发和测试分区从未用于构建原型或跨度分布. 因此,嵌入式选择并不是一个无标签程序:它假设一个贴有标签的目标训练集,或者一个等效的黄金跨的种子. 它没有使用的是评价集,因此后续的转移实验仍然未受污染. 我们把LinguaMeta和URIEL作为无标签基线,作为这些跨度措施的比较。

blocks.en: This method uses structured metadata such as script, geographic region, and language location to estimate cross-lingual relatedness ( Ritchie et al., 2024 ) . Individual features are normalised and combined into a single similarity score, capturing coarse-grained signals such as script compatibility and regional overlap. While simple and interpretable, this approach primarily reflects geographic and sociolinguistic proximity rather than linguistic structure.
blocks.zh: 这种方法使用脚本,地理区域,语言位置等结构化元数据来估计跨语言关联性(Ritchie等人,2024年). 单个特性被正常化,并合并为一个单一的相似性分数,捕捉粗糙的信号,如脚本兼容性和区域重叠. 这种方法虽然简单易懂,但主要反映了地理和社会语言的接近性,而不是语言结构。

blocks.en: This method represents languages using typological feature vectors derived from URIEL ( Littell et al., 2017 ) , accessed via lang2vec. We use concatenated syntactic and phonological vectors derived from resources such as WALS ( Dryer and Haspelmath, 2013 ) and PHOIBLE ( Moran and McCloy, 2019 ) . Similarity is computed using cosine similarity between these vectors, yielding a linguistically grounded measure that reflects structural similarity between languages.
blocks.zh: 这种方法代表语言使用从URIEL衍生出来的类型特征向量(Littell等人,2017年),通过lang2vec访问. 我们使用由WALS(干燥器和Haspelmath,2013年)和PHOIBLE(Moran和McCloy,2019年)等资源衍生的合成和唱片载体. 使用这些矢量之间的同位素相似性计算出相似性,从而产生一种基于语言的衡量标准,反映语言之间的结构相似性.

blocks.en: This representation-based metric operates directly in multilingual embedding space. For each language, gold entity spans from the corresponding training split are encoded using a pretrained multilingual model and aggregated into entity-type prototypes via mean pooling. Similarity is computed as cosine similarity between corresponding Runyankore and auxiliary prototypes, capturing alignment of named entities in the model’s representation space. This method is layer-dependent, and similarity is computed separately at each encoder layer. Recent work has shown that model-based similarity measures can outperform hand-crafted feature-based methods for transfer prediction ( Deshpande et al., 2022 ; Dou and Neubig, 2021 ; Muller et al., 2021 ; Ebrahimi et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种基于代表性的衡量标准直接在多语种嵌入空间运作。 对每种语言来说,从相应的培训分拆开始的黄金实体使用经过预先训练的多语种模型编码,并通过平均集合被汇总成实体类型的原型。 相似性作为相应的Runyankore和辅助原型的同位素相似性计算,在模型的表示空间中捕捉到命名实体的对齐性. 这种方法依赖层,在每个编码器层分别计算相似性. 最近的工作表明,基于模型的相似性测量可以超过手工制作的特征预测方法(Deshpande等人,2022年;Dou和Neubig,2021年;Muller等人,2021年;Ebrahimi等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Runyankore NER transfer performance by auxiliary language ordered according to LinguaMeta similarity relative to Runyankore. Languages are arranged from highest to lowest similarity. Solid lines indicate cross-lingual zero-shot transfer, while dashed lines indicate multilingual fine-tuning performance.
blocks.zh: 图1:根据LinguaMeta与Runyankore的相似性按辅助语言订购的Runyankore NER传输性能. 语言由最高到最低的相似性排列. 实线表示跨语言的零射转,而虚线表示多语言的微调性能.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Runyankore NER transfer performance by auxiliary language ordered according to URIEL typological similarity relative to Runyankore.
blocks.zh: 图2: Runyankore NER按照URIEL类型学相对Runyankore的相似性按辅助语言订购的传输性能.

blocks.en: SWD compares full distributions of entity-span embeddings rather than only their means, using the same training-split spans as the cosine prototypes. It approximates the Wasserstein-1 distance by projecting embeddings onto multiple random directions and averaging one-dimensional distances ( Nguyen et al., 2020 ) . Unlike cosine similarity, SWD captures higher-order geometric differences such as dispersion and multimodality, providing a richer notion of representational similarity.
blocks.zh: 社署比较实体-span嵌入物的完整分布,而不是仅比较其手段,使用与余弦原型相同的训练-分跨. 它通过将嵌入到多个随机方向和平均一维距离上来推测瓦瑟斯坦-1的距离(Nguyen等人,2020年). 与同位素相似性不同,社署捕捉到分布和多模式等更高顺序的几何差异,提供了更丰富的代表性相似性概念.

blocks.en: 5.2 Which similarity metrics predict transfer?
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 哪些相似度指标预测转移?

blocks.en: We evaluate predictive usefulness by computing Spearman ρ \rho between similarity scores and Runyankore NER F 1 F_{1} across n = 20 n=20 auxiliary languages. For LinguaMeta and URIEL, we use a single similarity score per language. For prototype cosine similarity and SWD, which are layer-dependent, we report the strongest observed Spearman correlation across layers. Because this best-layer choice is optimistic, we treat those coefficients as an upper bound on the layer-wise signal rather than as a pre-specified test. Table 4 marks two-tailed significance under the standard t t approximation for Spearman ρ \rho with n = 20 n=20 (critical | ρ | ≈ 0.44 |\rho|\approx 0.44 at p < 0.05 p<0.05 and | ρ | ≈ 0.56 |\rho|\approx 0.56 at p < 0.01 p<0.01 ).
blocks.zh: 我们通过计算 Spearman ^\rho 在相似性分数和 Runyankore NER F 1 F_{1} 跨越 n = 20 n = 20 辅助语言之间,来评估预测的有用性。 对于LinguaMeta和URIEL,每个语言都使用单一的相似性分数. 对于原型的同位素相似性和依赖层的社署,我们报告各层观测到的最强的斯皮尔曼关联. 由于这个最优级的选择是乐观的,我们把这些系数当作层层信号上的上方约束,而不是预先指定的测试. 表4标注了Spearman à \ rho标准 t 近似值下两尾值,为 n = 20 n = 20 (临界值 | ρ 0.44 |\rho |\ approx approx 0.44,p < 0.05 p < 0.05  and ρ 0.56 |\rho |\ |\ approx approx 0.56,p < 0.01 p < 0.01 ).

blocks.en:
Correlation coefficients are presented in Table 4 . Coefficients are higher for zero-shot transfer than multilingual fine-tuning, confirming that auxiliary language selection is most critical when no Runyankore supervision is available for the NER model itself.
Among linguistically-informed methods, typological similarity (URIEL) provides a more consistent signal than language metadata (LinguaMeta), although several LinguaMeta coefficients are not significant at n = 20 n=20 .
Embedding-based metrics are the most informative: the strongest cosine and SWD zero-shot correlations reach p < 0.01 p<0.01 , but the Afro-XLMR multilingual cosine coefficient and several SWD multilingual coefficients are not significant.
These results support embedding-based similarity as a stronger predictor of transfer than metadata or typology, while remaining compatible with a modest sample of twenty auxiliaries.
blocks.zh:
相关系数见表4。 零射线传输的协同率高于多语种微调,证实辅助语言选择在NER模型本身没有Runyankore监管时最为关键.
在语言知情的方法中,类型学的相似性(URIEL)比语言元数据(LinguaMeta)提供更一致的信号,虽然在n=20n=20时,一些LinguaMeta系数并不显著.
嵌入式计量法信息最为丰富:最强的余弦和社署零射线相关联达到p < 0.01 p < 0.01,但非洲-XLMR多语种余弦系数和几个社署多语种系数并不显著.
这些结果支持基于嵌入的类似性,作为比元数据或类型更强的转移预测器,同时与20个辅助样本保持适度兼容.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Runyankore NER transfer performance by auxiliary language ordered according to prototype cosine similarity relative to Runyankore.
blocks.zh: 图3 Runyankore NER的转录性能,按原型与Runyankore的余弦相似度按辅助语言订购.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Runyankore NER transfer performance by auxiliary language ordered according to Sliced Wasserstein Distance (SWD) similarity relative to Runyankore. Lower SWD values indicate stronger representational similarity.
blocks.zh: 图4:根据Sliced Wasserstein远程(SWD)与Runyankore的相似性,按辅助语言订购的Runyankore NER传输性能. 社署的数值较低,说明代表性的相似性较强。

blocks.en: 5.3 Similarity ordering and transfer performance
blocks.zh: 5.3 类似命令和转移性能

blocks.en: Figures 1 , 2 , 3 , and 4 plot Runyankore NER transfer performance across auxiliary languages, ordered according to each similarity metric.
blocks.zh: 图1、图2、图3和图4图Runyankore NER在辅助语言之间的传输性能,按每个类似度量进行订购。

blocks.en: These plots provide a detailed visualisation of the results underlying the trends in Table 4 . The weaker correlations of linguistic resource-based methods are reflected in the more unstable performance patterns of Figures 1 and 2 . While these metrics are broadly predictive (very high-similarity languages tend to transfer better than very low-similarity ones), performance varies substantially across individual language rankings.
blocks.zh: 这些图案详细描绘了表4所列趋势背后的结果。 语言资源方法的较弱相关性反映在图1和图2的较不稳定的性能模式中。 虽然这些衡量标准具有广泛的预测性(非常相似性强的语言往往比非常低的相似性强),但各个语言排名的绩效差别很大。

blocks.en: In contrast, embedding-based similarity measures produce more consistent alignment between similarity ordering and transfer effectiveness, as shown in Figure 3 , and 4 . This is especially visible for prototype cosine similarity in Figure 3 , where we see a clear relationship between similarity and transfer performance for the languages closest to Runyankore in multilingual embedding space. Embedding-based cosine similarity offers a more precise signal than linguistic resource-based metrics, distinguishing between individual top-ranked auxiliary language candidates rather than only separating highly dissimilar languages.
blocks.zh: 如图3和图4所示,与此相反,基于嵌入的相似性措施在相似性顺序和转让效力之间产生了更为一致的配合。 这在图3中的原型同位素相似性特别明显,我们看到在多语种嵌入空间中最接近Runyankore的语言的相似性与传输性能之间有着明确的关系. 嵌入式同位素相似性提供了比语言资源度量更精确的信号,区分了个别排名最高的辅助语言考生,而不是仅仅分离出高度不相似的语言.

blocks.en: The plots also show a strong regime-dependent pattern. In the cross-lingual zero-shot setting, transfer performance varies substantially across auxiliary languages, indicating that auxiliary language selection is important when no Runyankore supervision is available. In contrast, multilingual fine-tuning produces substantially flatter transfer curves, suggesting that auxiliary language similarity becomes less important once modest amounts of Runyankore supervision are introduced.
blocks.zh: 这些阴谋还显示出一种依赖政权的强烈模式。 在跨语言的零镜头设定中,辅助语言的传输性能差异很大,表明在没有Runyankore监管时,辅助语言选择很重要. 与此相反,多语种微调产生实质性的奉承转移曲线,表明辅助语言相似性在引入微量Runyankore监管后变得不那么重要.

blocks.en: Table 5: Runyankore NER performance under different auxiliary language selection schemes. Top-ranked quartets are shown for each similarity scheme, alongside the most similar single auxiliary language per scheme. Bold indicates the highest value in each column.
blocks.zh: 表5:不同辅助语言选择方案下的Runyankore NER性能. 每个相似度方案都显示排名最高的四重奏,每个方案都有最相似的单一辅助语言。 粗体表示每栏最高值.

blocks.en: 5.4 From individual languages to auxiliary language groups
blocks.zh: 5.4 从个别语言到辅助语言组

blocks.en: In many multilingual transfer settings, supervision is drawn from groups of auxiliary languages rather than a single source language ( Shaffer, 2021 ; Ebrahimi et al., 2025 ) . We therefore extend the analysis from individual auxiliary languages to auxiliary language quartets. For each similarity metric, languages were first ranked according to their similarity to Runyankore. We then constructed language quartets by selecting the four highest-ranked auxiliary languages under each similarity scheme (the first two columns of Table 5 list the resulting language groups). For layer-dependent embedding-based metrics, rankings were averaged across all layers and the three multilingual PLMs to obtain a model-agnostic ordering. The resulting quartets therefore represent the strongest auxiliary language groups predicted by each similarity metric.
blocks.zh: 在许多多语种的传输环境中,监管来自辅助语言组而不是单一源语言(Shaffer,2021;Ebrahimi等人,2025.). 因此,我们把分析从个别辅助语言扩大到辅助语言四重奏。 对于每种相似度度量,语言首先根据其与Runyankore的相似度排序. 然后,我们通过在每个相似性方案下选择四个排位最高的辅助语言来构建语言四重奏(表5的前两栏列出了由此产生的语言组)。 对于依赖层的嵌入度量衡,在所有层和三个多语种的PLM中均分排名,以获得模型不可知排序. 因此,由此产生的四重奏代表了每个类似度量度所预测的最强辅助语言组.

blocks.en:
Table 5 reports F 1 scores for the highest-ranked quartet under each method.
We compare these results to the top-ranked single auxiliary language predicted by each similarity metric (similarly averaged for the embedding-based metrics).
In the zero-shot setting, using multiple auxiliary languages consistently outperforms using a single auxiliary language, with quartets improving mean F 1 by several points. In multilingual fine-tuning, this advantage largely disappears: differences between quartets and single auxiliaries are small, suggesting that once Runyankore supervision is available, additional auxiliary languages offer little benefit.
blocks.zh:
表5 报告 每种方法下排名最高的四重奏的F1得分.
我们把这些结果与每个相似度度量预测的排名最高的单一辅助语言(类似嵌入度量的平均值)进行比较.
在零拍设定中,使用多种辅助语言,使用单一辅助语言的成绩一致,四重奏改进了平均值F 1的分数. 在多语种微调中,这种优势基本上消失了:四重奏和单辅音之间的差别很小,说明一旦有了Runyankore监督,额外的辅音就没有什么好处.

blocks.en: The results reaffirm that, in cross-lingual zero-shot transfer, auxiliary language selection is crucial. Cosine-based quartets consistently achieve the best performance across all models, followed by LinguaMeta and SWD. As in individual auxiliary language selection, embedding representation-based similarity is more effective for selecting transfer languages.
blocks.zh: 结果再次证明,在跨语言零镜头传输中,辅助语言选择至关重要. 以余弦为基础的四重奏持续取得所有模式的最佳表现,其次是LinguaMeta和社署。 和个别辅助语言选择一样,嵌入基于代表的相似性对选择传输语言更有效.

blocks.en: Performance differences between quartets are much smaller in multilingual fine-tuning than in zero-shot transfer. Performance converges across grouping strategies, and no single method consistently dominates. As in individual auxiliary language selection, once modest Runyankore supervision is available, the importance of auxiliary group language selection is substantially reduced.
blocks.zh: 四方之间的性能差异在多语种微调中比零镜头传输中要小得多. 业绩在各组别战略之间趋同,没有一个单一方法始终占主导地位。 和个别辅助语言选择一样,一旦有了微小的Runyankore监督,辅助群体语言选择的重要性就大大降低.

blocks.en: These results reinforce the earlier findings. Auxiliary language selection is critical under cross-lingual zero-shot transfer, where embedding-based similarity provides the strongest guidance. Under multilingual fine-tuning, however, the effect of auxiliary choice is substantially reduced.
blocks.zh: 这些结果加强了先前的调查结果。 辅助语言选择在跨语言零镜头传输中至关重要,其中基于嵌入的相似性提供了最强的指导. 然而,在多语种微调下,辅助选择的效果大大降低。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced RunyaNER, the first publicly available NER dataset for Runyankore, and established benchmark results for Runyankore NER using multilingual PLMs under monolingual, zero-shot, and multilingual fine-tuning settings.
Our experiments show that auxiliary language selection is particularly important in cross-lingual zero-shot transfer, where closely related Great Lakes Bantu languages yield the strongest transfer performance. Embedding-based similarity measures, computed from labelled training spans rather than from the evaluation set, correlate more strongly with downstream transfer effectiveness than metadata-based or typological approaches, while auxiliary language choice becomes substantially less important once Runyankore supervision is introduced through multilingual fine-tuning.
We hope that RunyaNER will support future research on low-resource African NLP and multilingual transfer learning.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了 RunyaNER,这是 Runyankore 的第一个可公开获取的 NER 数据集, 并建立了 Runyankore NER 的基准结果, 使用多语言的 PLM 在单一语言,零镜头, 和多语言的微调设置下。
我们的实验表明,辅助语言的选用在跨语言的零镜头传输中特别重要,在那里,密切相关的五大湖班图语言产生最强的传输性能. 嵌入式相似性衡量标准从标有标记的培训周期而不是评价组合计算,与基于元数据或类型学方法的下游转移效力相比,更紧密地联系在一起,而一旦通过多语种微调引入Runyankore监督,辅助语言选择就变得不那么重要。
我们希望,RunyaNER将支持今后关于非洲低资源新语言和多语种转让学习的研究。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This study focuses only on Runyankore NER, and the observed auxiliary-language selection patterns may not generalise to other NLP tasks or languages. Our experiments are limited to three encoder-based multilingual models and twenty African auxiliary languages, which restricts broader architectural and linguistic coverage and yields modest power for Spearman tests ( n = 20 n=20 ). RunyaNER was annotated and verified by a single L1 speaker, so we cannot report inter-annotator agreement; quality rests on exhaustive guideline-based correction rather than multi-annotator adjudication. In addition, the two sources of the dataset are concentrated in relatively similar domains. Embedding-based similarity measures require gold entity spans from the target training split and are therefore not a label-free selection method; they also depend on modelling choices such as encoder layer selection and embedding aggregation, which were not evaluated exhaustively. We report the strongest layer-wise correlation for those metrics, which should be read as an upper bound.
blocks.zh: 本研究仅关注Runyankore NER,观测到的辅助语言选择模式可能不会泛指其他NLP任务或语言. 我们的实验仅限于三种基于编码器的多语种模型和20种非洲辅助语言,这限制了更广泛的建筑和语言覆盖范围,并给斯皮尔曼测试提供了适度的功率(n=20n=20). RunyaNER是由一名L1发言者作说明和核实的,因此我们不能报告通知人之间的协议;质量取决于详尽无遗的基于准则的更正,而不是多通知人的裁决。 此外,数据集的两个来源集中在相对相似的领域. 基于嵌入的类似度测量要求黄金实体从目标训练分裂中跨出,因此不是无标签的选择方法;它们还依赖于编码器层选择和嵌入聚合等建模选择,这些选择没有经过详尽的评价. 我们报告与这些衡量标准最强的分层关系,应将其理解为上限。
